name: Harmony 700, the charging screen with Logitech's own configuration
description: todo-compile-700 1.4, the control for section 383: on our empty configuration no charging screen showed on a phone charger, with either set of batteries. Logitech's own configuration, the one the remote held before, is back on it unchanged. The question is only whether this configuration shows a charging screen, a battery filling up under a lightning bolt, with these batteries; nothing is predicted, and nothing is sent, so the Flirc hears nothing. Use the mark button to say what the screen shows at each step.

steps.instruction: Unplug the cable. Expect Logitech's own screens for the activities this configuration holds. Say what the screen shows
With the new, charged batteries in, plug the remote into the phone charger. Say whether a charging screen appears, what it looks like, and whether it changes. Unplug it and say where the remote goes
With the old, defective set in, plug the remote into the phone charger. Say what the screen shows
If a set has been drained with a load, put it in and plug the remote into the phone charger. Say what the screen shows. Skip this step otherwise
